(2) CONSTRUCT AUDIT (hop 20, every refusal MEASURED on the DRPLi compiler,
NOT a DR claim): COMPLEX FLOAT(18) REFUSED (codegen: call to unknown complex
[TBD]); CONTROLLED + ALLOCATE/FREE REFUSED (call to unknown controlled [TBD]);
HBOUND REFUSED (expression form not in int subset [TBD]); the FIXED builtin
(fixed(data(i),25,12)) and EXP REFUSED (same int-subset refusal); FIXED
BINARY(31) REFUSED (bind: exceeds DR's FIXED precision limit 15, PL/I-80 V1.4
says NOT IMP); OPTIONS(MAIN,REORDER) REFUSED (block option REORDER deferred);
the whole-array actual (declare b(*) + call p(a)) PARSE-FAILS; a recursive
fixed-formal function COMPILES rc=0 but its lane-B RUN is unwitnessed - NOT
used here.
(3) COMPLEX -> two parallel AUTO arrays xr(8)/xi(8) fixed bin(15) in Q6 fixed
point, scale 64 (declared numerical adaptation); the input (1,1,1,1,0,0,0,0)
becomes the seed (64,0) x 4 + (0,0) x 4, explicitly zero-initialised in a loop
(the initial content of an un-initialised static DATA segment is UNMEASURED
on lane B).
(4) RECURSION -> iterative radix-2 DIT Cooley-Tukey: THREE explicit stages over
bit-reversed pairs - stage 1 the do j = 1 to 7 by 2 loop (four butterflies,
W^0); stage 2 pairs (1,3)(2,4)(5,7)(6,8) (W^0/W^2); stage 3 pairs (1,5)(2,6)
(3,7)(4,8) (W^0/W^1/W^2/W^3). Twelve bf calls, asserted by the derivation.
(5) TWIDDLE QUANTIZATION: no cos/sin/exp in the measured subset - the twiddles
are precomputed integer literals W^0=(64,0), W^1=(45,-45), W^2=(0,-64),
W^3=(-45,-45) with 45 = trunc(64*sqrt(2)/2) (45.25 -> 45; the sqrt law is
computed in the derivation, declared adaptation). Worst component error vs the
exact DFT 0.0080, inside the declared tolerance 0.02. Every /64 rescale is
EXACT on this input (the models assert divisibility), so no rounding ambiguity
arises anywhere in the port.
(6) SG-FLAG COMPARISON GAP (measured on my compiler, DR behaviour UNMEASURED,
NOT a DR claim): nested two-variable ordered compares are unsampled in EITHER
order (both operands deref: if v < z and its swap if z > v both REFUSE -
codegen [TBD] pointer formal as the FIRST operand of a two-variable compare
is unsampled). FIX used by the pin: the sign test runs in MAIN over same-frame
scalars (t = xr(i); sg = 0; if t < z then sg = 1; - the FP00 lane-B RUN-
witnessed shape) and prn uses only formal-vs-LITERAL equality (if sg = 1 then
..., the DHRY putc-ladder shape).
(7) EXPRESSION-ACTUAL GAP (measured, my-gap class crash witness, NOT a DR
statement): call p(0 - 45) REFUSED with an internal pool demand/layout
mismatch (prescan demanded 2 pool bytes, lowering allocated 5); every CALL
actual in this pin is a plain scalar name. Negative-literal stores (w1i = -45)
and (m+31)/64-style parenthesized dividends were MEASURED ACCEPTED (hop 20).
(8) THE EDIT: fixed(data(i),25,12) becomes sign / %9d integer / '.' / three
digits via nested prn + the pdig digit ladder (ip = s/64; rem = s - ip*64;
th = (rem*1000)/64; hh/t10/uu by the same division law; if d = k then ch =
'<k>'). MEASURED BOUND: the digit path computes rem*1000 with 0 <= rem <= 63,
up to 63000 which EXCEEDS the FIXED BIN(15) range - safe ONLY because every
rem on THIS input is 0 or 26 (max 26000); asserted by the derivation's
max_magnitude invariant so the prn printer is never reused blindly on another
input.
(9) RUNTIME LAWS USED (FP00 lane-B RUN probe, evidence build/fc01-scratch/
fft00/fp00-evidence/, my compiler edce9e0e..., NOT DR claims): signed 16-bit
multiply exact in all four sign arms; fixed-bin division TRUNCATES TOWARD ZERO
(-2881/64=-45, -2879/64=-44); a negative fixed bin(15) PUT renders
right-justified in the 9-column field WITH its sign; scalar-vs-scalar
if b < z (z a zero-valued variable) RUNS correct; the single-item PUT
separator law holds across statements.
(10) NO INPUT: pure-PUT program - console_input is a bare ^Z; the script
asserts no GET statement exists.
(11) FRAMING [C352]: 13 normalized lines = "", banner, scale line, "", 8
X-lines, ""; the stream starts with ONE blank line (first PUT SKIP) and ends
with the PUT SKIP before stop plus the single exit CRLF. Every emitted segment
is <= 78 columns, so the PROPOSED 79-column PLILIB wrap never fires (the wrap
law stays proposed, not a DR claim).
(12) DERIVATION: expected.console is GENERATED from reference.py:fft00, a
statement-for-statement mirror of THIS pinned source (including the sg-flag
statement order), and was diffed BYTE-EQUAL against the independent simulator
build/fc01-scratch/fft00/fft00_sim.py check() on all 13 normalized lines AND
the raw 507-byte stream (sha 87acbf18...) BEFORE this JSON was written; this

(13) INDEPENDENT VALUE CHECKS carried by fft00(): (a) the port final state
